name: IRIS Founder Command Center
purpose: Provide the Founder with one local-first governed interface for submitting objectives, reviewing proposals and approvals, inspecting missions, workers, evidence, audit history, blueprints, and IRIS health without granting the interface independent execution authority.
functionalRequirements: Accept a Founder objective as a draft and display its risk and authorization classification before any action workflow begins.
Display exact proposals, bound digests, requested authority, affected resources, verification plans, rollback plans, and approval state.
Require the existing IRIS approval boundary to validate and consume protected approvals; the application must never self-approve.
Show mission decomposition, dependencies, blockers, evidence requirements, progress, and recommended next work.
Show temporary-worker identity, mission, permissions, runtime limits, lifecycle, results, termination, and cleanup evidence.
Show evidence-linked audit history and integrity status without permitting record mutation.
Open canonical infrastructure blueprints and their validation, provenance, security, resource, cost, rollback, and cleanup information.
Show local IRIS component and model-runtime health without exposing secrets, chain-of-thought, credentials, or unrestricted logs.
Operate on local development data with no public listener, cloud dependency, telemetry, paid service, or external account in the first release.
Fail closed when identity, policy, evidence, model, repository, or service state is unavailable or contradictory.
